defs.def: to show sth clearly by giving proof or evidence 证明；证实；论证；说明

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现这样做能给我的教学注入活力、吸引学生，并向他们说明抽象概念如何在现实中展现。

ex.s: However, my students demonstrated something more important to me.
ex.t: 然而，我的学生向我展示了更重要的东西。

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而，心理学家已证明，当成年人阅读新闻时，他们记住的内容比听或看相同报道更多。

ex.s: Note to teachers: Children’s Theatre has a study guide demonstrating how math and science can be taught through “Tom Sawyer.” For downloadable lessons, visit the official website of Children’s Theatre.
ex.t: 给教师说明：儿童剧院有一份学习指南，说明如何通过《汤姆·索亚》教授数学和科学。

defs.def: to show by your actions that you have a particular quality, feeling or opinion 表达；表露；表现；显露

ex.s: To help students demonstrate their computer skills.
ex.t: 帮助学生展示他们的计算机技能。

ex.s: In Japan, it may demonstrate respect to look down when talking to an older person.
ex.t: 在日本，与长辈说话时低头可能表达尊重。

ex.s: When you read an essay about scientific issues, you can try drawing a diagram, which will not only allow you to visualise the problems more clearly but also can help demonstrate your creative thinking and problem-solving.
ex.t: 当你读关于科学问题的文章时，可以尝试画图表，这不仅能让你更清楚地可视化问题，还能帮助展示你的创造性思维和解决问题能力。

defs.def: to show and explain how sth works or how to do sth 示范；演示

ex.s: “The way they demonstrated how microplastics were trapped through the boiling process was nice,” Caroline Gauchotte-Lindsay, an environmental engineer of the University of Glasgow in Scotland who was not involved in the research, tells New Scientist.
ex.t: “他们演示微塑料如何通过煮沸过程被截留，做得很好，”未参与该研究的格拉斯哥大学环境工程师卡罗琳·高乔特-林赛告诉《新科学家》。

ex.s: We will be holding a free taster session on 23rd May, at 10 am, to demonstrate the variety of effective and active exercises.
ex.t: 我们将在5月23日上午10点举行免费体验课，演示各种有效且积极的练习。

ex.s: At the Chinese art festival, there are different stands                   artists demonstrate their skills and teach the visitors.
ex.t: 有不同的展位，艺术家展示技能并教游客。

ex.s: There were different stands where artists could demonstrate their skills and teach the visitors!
ex.t: 有不同的展位，艺术家可以展示技能并教游客！

ex.s: REFLECTING crucial perceive lack component demonstrate interact stare at embarrassment UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE UNIT 4 BODY LANGUAGE 1 In groups, brainstorm a list of different kinds of body language.
ex.t: 反思 关键的 感知 缺乏 组成部分 展示 互动 盯着 尴尬 身体语言 1 分组头脑风暴不同种类的身体语言。

ex.s: She planned to give two 15-minute lessons from orbit: the first to demonstrate the controls of the spacecraft and explain how gravity worked, and the second to describe the objectives of the Challenger programme.
ex.t: 她计划从轨道上进行两节15分钟的课：第一节演示航天器的操控并解释重力如何运作，第二节描述挑战者计划的目标。

defs.def: to take part in a public meeting or march, usually as a protest or to show support for sth 游行示威
